site.name: pelagic
site.summary: pelagic-clone Marketing site (landing page) for the fictional open-source vector database Pelagic. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Single-page landing: top nav + animated GitHub-stars counter pill; hero with title, dual CTAs, `pip install` copy strip, rotating benchmark numbers, right-side 4-language (Python / Node / Go / curl) code tabs; Trusted-by logo row; 3 core-feature cards; Ingest → Index → Query three-step flow; architecture SVG diagram; customer quote cards; left Blog 5 posts + right Changelog 5 entries dual feed; 4-column footer with sitemap | | `styles.css` | Brand color #0E5C8A deep-sea blue; Inter + JetBrains Mono; responsive at 3 breakpoints (>1100 / 880–1100 / <880) | | `script.js` | Stars-counter 1.2s eased animation; code tabs switch Python / Node / Go / curl; benchmark rows rotate every 2.5s; `pip install pelagic` copy toast; fictional-logo rendering |

explored_user_goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full pelagic system, prioritizing the primary landing flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
exploration_summary: The pelagic landing page has strong feedback for the 'Copy' button and functional code tabs, but many links (e.g., 'RFC tracker', 'GitHub stars') lack interaction feedback, and mobile tap targets for links/code tabs are often below 44px guidance. Key untested areas include full 'Pricing' and 'Quickstart' link functionality on desktop, though mobile 'Quickstart' works. Failures in blog post link clicks suggest potential non-functional links or targeting issues.

exploration_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the Pelagic landing page, validating primary flows (hero, code tabs, features) and responsive behavior across viewports.
exploration_plan.summary: Start with desktop exploration of the index.html landing page, validating interactive elements (code tabs, copy button, nav links) and animations. Then repeat critical checks in mobile viewport, focusing on tap targets and responsive layout. Ensure all visible controls and animations are exercised.
assumptions: Only index.html exists (no adjacent pages), so exploration focuses on this single page with multiple states (code tabs, benchmark rotations, responsive breakpoints).
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (all clickables <44px height/width, per layout warnings)

phases.title: Desktop Hero & Nav
phases.objective: Validate hero interactables (Quickstart, GitHub, Copy) and nav links, check animations (stars, benchmarks)
exit_criteria: All hero interactables exercised, animations visible

phases.title: Desktop Code Tabs
phases.objective: Validate code tab switching (python→node→go→curl) for content change and responsiveness
exit_criteria: All 4 code tabs switch content, no errors

phases.title: Desktop Features & Footer
phases.objective: Explore core feature cards, 3-step flow, architecture, blog/changelog, footer links
key_checks: Scroll to feature cards (hybrid, FAISS, self-host) and check headings
Scroll to 3-step flow (Ingest→Index→Query) and verify text
Scroll to blog/changelog feeds (5 posts each) and check links
exit_criteria: All core sections scrolled, key links exercised

phases.title: Mobile Viewport (max 880px)
phases.objective: Validate responsive layout, tap targets, and critical interactables (Quickstart, Copy, code tabs) on mobile
key_checks: Resize viewport <880px, check nav collapse (if any)
Tap code tabs (node→curl) on mobile (check content)
Verify tap targets (e.g., Quickstart, GitHub) for size/responsiveness
exit_criteria: Critical interactables work on mobile, layout responsive

phases.title: Mobile Tap Target Validation
phases.objective: Recheck small tap targets (layout warnings) on mobile for usability
exit_criteria: All small tap targets respond, no usability issues

coverage_targets.features: Exercise all visible controls (5 buttons, 21 links, 4 tabs) on index.html
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (hero, code tabs, copy, nav) on mobile viewport

notes: Focus on the single page (index.html) due to prescan showing only one HTML file. Prioritize interactive elements with layout warnings (small tap targets) for deeper validation.

findings.user_goal: Interact with links/code tabs on mobile
findings.problem: Many mobile tap targets (e.g., 'Pelagic' link, code tabs, 'Overview'/'Hybrid search' links) are below 44px height guidance, reducing usability for thumb interactions.
findings.evidence: Layout warnings show tap targets like 'Pelagic' (100x28px), 'python' tab (71x32px), and 'Overview' link (159x29px) are below 44px height. Mobile testing confirmed code tabs work but have small targets.
findings.why_it_matters: Small tap targets increase error rates for mobile users, making it hard to interact with links/tabs accurately.
findings.suggestion: Increase tap target heights to at least 44px (e.g., adjust link padding, code tab sizes) for mobile viewports.
findings.source_hint: index.html: various links/code tabs (e.g., ux-1, ux-7, ux-11)

findings.problem: Links like 'GitHub stars', 'RFC tracker', 'Pelagic' (top) show no interaction feedback (e.g., URL change, animation) on click, confusing users about functionality.
findings.evidence: Clicking 'GitHub stars' (ux-2) and 'RFC tracker' (ux-22) had no visible state change. 'Pelagic' link (ux-1) also failed to navigate/feedback.
findings.why_it_matters: Lack of feedback makes users unsure if links work, reducing trust and usability.
findings.suggestion: Add interaction feedback (e.g., URL change, hover/active states, animations) to non-navigational links or ensure functional links navigate/load content.

findings.problem: The 'Why we rewrote our HNSW build in Rust' blog post link failed to navigate/scroll despite multiple click attempts, suggesting it may be non-functional (e.g., href='#') or have targeting issues.
findings.evidence: Repeated click actions (with/without target_id) failed, showing timeouts or no URL change. The link’s href may be misconfigured (e.g., '#').
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t access blog content, reducing engagement with product updates/guides.
findings.suggestion: Fix the link’s href to point to the blog post (e.g., valid URL) and ensure it’s clickable with proper targeting.
findings.source_hint: index.html: 'Why we rewrote our HNSW build in Rust' (ux-27)

findings.problem: The 'Copy' button works (shows toast feedback), but other interactive elements (e.g., 'View on GitHub' button, 'Quickstart' link) have inconsistent feedback (e.g., 'View on GitHub' changes URL but no new tab/feedback).
findings.evidence: Clicking 'Copy' shows 'Copied pip install pelagic' toast, but 'View on GitHub' only changes URL to '#' (no new tab/modal), and 'Quickstart' navigates but has small target.
findings.why_it_matters: Inconsistent feedback confuses users about what actions succeed (e.g., 'View on GitHub' may seem broken if no new tab opens).
findings.suggestion: Standardize feedback: ensure 'View on GitHub' opens a new tab, add hover/active states to buttons/links, and confirm navigation feedback is clear.

findings.problem: Links like 'Benchmarks', 'Managed', 'Migration guides' failed to navigate/scroll, suggesting they may be non-functional or misconfigured.
findings.evidence: Clicking 'Benchmarks' (ux-21) and 'Managed' (ux-13) had no visible navigation. 'Migration guides' click also failed.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t access key product sections (e.g., benchmarks, migration docs), hindering goal completion.
findings.suggestion: Fix link hrefs to point to valid sections/URLs and ensure smooth navigation on click.

findings.problem: The 'GitHub stars' link shows no interaction feedback (e.g., navigation to GitHub, star count animation), reducing trust in the project’s popularity.
findings.evidence: Clicking 'GitHub stars' (ux-6) had no visible state change (e.g., no new tab, no animation), despite being clickable.
findings.why_it_matters: Lack of feedback makes users doubt the star count’s authenticity, reducing social proof impact.
findings.suggestion: Add feedback (e.g., open GitHub repo in new tab, animate star count) to the 'GitHub stars' link.

gaps: 41 browser action(s) failed and should be retried or analyzed.
